_notes.levelTargets: index = round (index 0 unused), value = the 调度中心 level the guide levels to that round when funds allow (guides/policy.mjs prep)
_notes.g06: the guide as is (guides/g06_final.json): 5 at R9, never 6
_notes.owner: the owner's median level per round over the 6 recorded matches 2026-10-18..20 (matches/*.jsonl, last PREP row of each round)
_notes.fast6: g06 one round earlier from R3 and 6 from R11
_notes.slow: g06 about two rounds later, 5 only at R12
_notes.sloppy: g06 plus, with chance 0.3 per turn, 1-3 random legal economy actions first (advisor/actions.mjs randomEconomy)
_notes.early: g06 one round earlier from R3, still capped at 5
_notes.blind: lines=mates scenario: p0 takes the guide's first-choice line even when a teammate is on it (the advisor before the team view)
_notes.teamview: lines=mates scenario: p0 takes the first-choice line no teammate is on (team view, nothing learned)
_notes.learned: team view + the learned profile: line by pickLine (learned line value for this boss), tempo = learned levelTargets
_notes.owner_blind: the owner's tempo, line chosen without looking at teammates
_notes.learned_line: team view + learned line only (guide tempo)
_notes.learned_tempo: team view (first free line) + learned tempo only
